sentences.en: The hecklers were escorted from the venue by security officials.
sentences.zh: 安保人员把那些起哄的人带离了现场。

sentences.en: The streets were chocka when everyone spilled out of the venue.
sentences.zh: 所有人都从场地涌出来的时候，街道上挤满了人。

sentences.en: The date and venue for our next concert haven't been set yet.
sentences.zh: 我们下次演唱会的日期和地点还没有确定下来。

senses.zh: 审判地；犯罪地点；发生地点
